parts.text: {"title": "Guide", "sections": [{"heading": "Billing gateway", "text": "Billing moves to the new gateway on the first of November. The old gateway stays in read-only mode for ninety days. A failed charge is retried three times, one hour apart. After the third failure the invoice is marked as", "sources": ["doc-billing"]}, {"heading": "Search cluster", "text": "The search index is rebuilt every night at two in the morning. A rebuild takes about forty minutes for the largest organisation. Archived items stay out of the default search results. A filter shows archived items when asked.", "sources": ["doc-search"]}, {"heading": "Daily digest", "text": "The daily digest goes out at seven in the morning in the member's locale. A member with no activity in the window gets no digest. The digest lists the changed items and the comments addressed to the member. Counts in", "sources": ["doc-digest"]}, {"heading": "Offline drafts", "text": "A draft comment survives a page reload while offline. Drafts are kept in the browser for seven days. A draft is sent once when the connection returns. A draft older than seven days is dropped with a notice.", "sources": ["doc-drafts"]}, {"heading": "Certificate rotation", "text": "The signing certificate rotates every ninety days. The rotation runs without a restart of the service. An expired certificate is refused at sign-in with a clear message. The platform team is paged when a rotation fails.", "sources": ["doc-certificate"]}], "empty_reason": null, "rationale": "One section per source, in the sources' own words."}
